text: 1. Admission Application Form for International Students of Zhejiang University of Technology(Applicants must first fill in the information through the online application system for international students of Zhejiang University of Technology, http://apply.zstu.edu.cn/) 2. Copy of passport with the applicant's signature 3. For those already residing in China, a copy of the valid visa or residence permit for this entry is also required. 4. Notarized certificate of highest academic degree and academic transcript (original documents in languages other than Chinese or English should be accompanied by translations in Chinese or English) 5. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". Applicants must strictly follow the items required in the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" for the examination. Any missing items, those without the applicant's photo attached, or those with a seam seal on the photo, or those without the signatures and stamps of the doctor and the hospital are invalid. The examination results are valid for 6 months. 6. Copy of HSK certificate or copy of English proficiency certificate (if any) 7. Applicants who are currently studying at other universities in China are required to provide a study certificate, attendance record and academic transcript issued by the international student office of their respective schools. 8. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant legal documents from their legal guardians in China. These documents must be notarized by the Chinese embassy abroad. 9. 5 photos (Requirements: White background color photos, passport-sized photos. The photos should be submitted upon registration.) 10. Other required materials
